Web search (Sayreville/Parlin category queries) - Yellow Pages, BBB, Angi, HomeAdvisor, Thumbtack, Birdeye, Cylex, whereorg, Superpages, Nextdoor, BuildZoom, Patch, towing.com, roof.info, inspectree, painterguide, septic.com, localmovers.com surfaced via results

categories_thin: Water damage restoration: no clearly Sayreville-based independent firm found; results were out-of-town franchises and SERVPRO/ServiceMaster-type brands, which are excluded.
Security installers: only one Sayreville-address firm (G. Leff) plus one service-area electrician; most alarm companies with a Sayreville presence are based in Edison/South Amboy.
Siding/windows: the Sayreville-tagged results (A&E Exteriors, PJ Fitzpatrick, Star Windows) are based outside the borough, so they were left out; only two Sayreville-address siding firms surfaced.
Masonry/landscaping appear healthy but many listings are home-based operators with no published address.
caveats: Most large directories (Yellow Pages, Superpages, Manta, ChamberofCommerce.com, BBB, Angi, HomeAdvisor, BuildZoom, Cylex) block automated fetching; entries drawn from them come from search-result snippets and need triage confirmation.
Several small contractors share office/box addresses on Jernee Mill Rd and Hartle St (222 Jernee Mill Rd in particular).
Businesses commonly described as 'serving Sayreville' but based in Old Bridge, East Brunswick, South Amboy, South River or Monroe were excluded, since the zone is the borough itself.
data_gaps: Overpass/OpenStreetMap API unreachable from this environment.
Google Maps lite view returned only 5-10 results per query, so no category is guaranteed complete.
Phone numbers were not captured for firms whose only evidence was a name-only review profile.
Some listed addresses are residential-style units (home-based trade businesses); only published business addresses are recorded.
